title: 56th GST Council: rate rationalisation from 22 September 2025
summary: The 56th GST Council recommended a two-rate structure of a 18% standard rate, a 5% merit rate, and a special 40% de-merit rate, implemented from 22 September 2025 for services and most goods. The 12% slab is abolished and those supplies migrate to 5% or 18% (or another surviving treatment). The 28% de-merit slab becomes 40% for goods that move on this date. Pan masala, gutkha, cigarettes, chewing tobacco, unmanufactured tobacco, and bidi stay on their old GST rates plus compensation cess until 1 February 2026. These figures rest on official GST Council / PIB releases; the underlying CBIC notification PDFs were not opened.

legal_basis.title: Recommendations of the 56th Meeting of the GST Council (PIB press release, 03 Sep 2025)
legal_basis.instrument: GST Council / PIB press release with Annexures
legal_basis.pinpoint: 2-rate structure: Standard 18%, Merit 5%, special de-merit 40%; implementation paras a-d: services & most goods wef 22 Sep 2025; tobacco/pan masala deferred

legal_basis.title: FAQs-3 on decisions of the 56th GST Council (PIB, 18 Sep 2025)
legal_basis.pinpoint: Q1: Notification No. 9/2025-Central Tax (Rate) dt 17.9.2025 supersedes 1/2017-CT(Rate) dt 28.6.2017; Q2: 10/2025-CT(Rate) exemptions supersedes 2/2017; Q4: 2/2025-Compensation Cess (Rate)

changes.summary: The 12% GST slab ends on 21 September 2025. Supplies that had been at 12% migrate to 5%, 18%, or another surviving treatment as set out in the Council annexures.

migration_impact.summary: Do not issue 12% invoices for supplies from 22 September 2025. Recode each former 12% heading from the annexure (for example butter and ghee to 5%; certain works contracts and exploration services to 18%).

after.description: 12% slab retired. Destination rates are heading-specific.

changes.summary: The 5% merit rate continues and is widened to include supplies that previously sat in other slabs (for example several dairy products previously at 12%).

migration_impact.summary: Update item master data for headings that the annexure moves into 5%. The 5% figure itself does not change.

changes.summary: The de-merit path for goods that move on this date changes from 28% to 40%. Selected tobacco and pan masala goods are deferred to 1 February 2026.

migration_impact.summary: Invoices for de-merit goods that the annexure moves on 22 September 2025 use 40%. Deferred tobacco and pan masala goods stay on their previous GST rate plus compensation cess until 1 February 2026.

after.description: 40% de-merit rate, with tobacco/pan masala deferred.

changes.summary: 18% is restated as the standard rate. Some former 12% services move into 18%. The 18% figure itself does not change.

migration_impact.summary: Keep 18% as the ordinary rate. Recode headings that the annexure moves into 18%.
